description: Find stores where a saved check shows an AI agent can reach checkout. Filter by platform, protocol, category, or min_grade (optional, default none). With no filters, returns those stores and labels the result default: no filters given. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. A missing result is not counted against a store. No login and no new scan. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 10. Maximum 25.

min_grade.description: Optional: keep only stores whose current (not expired) Agent Readiness Grade is this letter or better (A, B, C, D or F). Default none: every store is listed. Expired and not-graded stores are left out when this is set.

platform.description: Commerce platform id, such as shopify or woocommerce.

protocol.description: ucp, webmcp, or mcp. ACP, PAP, and payments are not recorded per store.

name: find_stores
